comets.name: Grumble
comets.look: a lumpy grey moon-rock ball pocked with little craters, one bigger crater on its forehead like a bump
comets.expression: heavy half-closed grumpy eyes with tiny pupils; a flat wide frown with one chipped front tooth sticking up; a grumpy old rock

comets.name: Cinder
comets.look: a coal-black ball speckled with glowing orange embers, a short curl of solid smoke on top like a cowlick
comets.expression: huge round excited eyes glowing orange; a wide open laughing mouth with one single tooth; a hyperactive kid

comets.name: Flurry
comets.look: a packed snowball with a messy hairdo of icicle spikes on top, frosty blue shadows
comets.expression: squinting mischievous eyes; a cheeky grin with two big buck teeth of ice; a prankster

comets.name: Zap
comets.look: a round ball of bright yellow static fur standing on end, two lightning-bolt shaped ear spikes
comets.expression: wide shocked eyes with tiny dot pupils; a zigzag mouth; always startled

comets.name: Sprout
comets.look: a mossy green rock ball with a leafy sprout and tiny glowing mushrooms on its head
comets.expression: eyes closed in happy upside-down U curves; a small content smile and moss-pink cheeks; gentle and calm

comets.name: Magmaw
comets.look: a cracked black basalt shell over a molten core, two stubby horns, lava drooling from the jaw
comets.expression: angry slanted eyes glowing yellow; a huge underbite jaw with two tusks pointing up; a bully

comets.name: Gloop
comets.look: a bubbling toxic-green slime ball with a crusty purple rock crust grown over its top, bubbles rising inside
comets.expression: mismatched crazy eyes, one big and one small; a wide wobbly grin with the tongue lolling out; completely unhinged

comets.name: Geode
comets.look: a plain brown rock ball split open horizontally: the split is its mouth, lined with purple amethyst crystals that glow inside
comets.expression: two small faceted amethyst eyes, narrowed and cunning; the mouth is the geode crack with crystal teeth; sly

comets.name: Puffer
comets.look: a deep-space pufferfish puffed into a ball, covered in short spines, teal with glowing bioluminescent spots, small fins
comets.expression: big round watery fish eyes; a tiny puckered O-shaped mouth; nervous

comets.name: Scarab
comets.look: a space beetle rolled up into an armored ball: glossy metallic green-blue shell plates, two short antennae
comets.expression: two big glossy black bug eyes with a white highlight; small clicking mandibles; busy and fast

comets.name: Aurowl
comets.look: a round night-sky owl: feathers like dark blue crystal plates, green-violet northern lights flowing across its chest, two crystal ear tufts
comets.expression: huge calm round owl eyes with green-violet aurora irises; a small closed hooked beak; wise

comets.name: Bastion
comets.look: an armored knight ball of black volcanic glass with sharp faceted plates and a visor ridge across the face
comets.expression: two eyes glowing red through the narrow visor slit; the mouth hidden behind a grille of glass plates; stoic and silent

comets.name: Stormram
comets.look: a thundercloud ram: a body of dark sculpted storm-cloud wool with lightning glowing inside, two big curled ram horns of rock
comets.expression: fierce narrowed eyes glowing white-blue; gritted teeth with sparks between them; aggressive

comets.name: Prism
comets.look: a faceted clear gem ball that splits light into rainbows
comets.expression: diamond-shaped eyes; a smug one-sided smirk; arrogant

comets.name: Specter
comets.look: a translucent violet ghost orb with a soft wavy bottom edge (no wisps) and a dark rock skull-core visible inside
comets.expression: hollow round eye sockets with tiny white pinpoint pupils; a wide stitched creepy grin; unsettling

comets.name: Solaris
comets.look: a miniature sun of boiling plasma with a crown of solar-flare loops arching over the top (attached loops, nothing trailing)
comets.expression: confident narrowed eyes, white-hot; a proud closed-mouth smile; a king

comets.name: Leviathan
comets.look: a round deep-space whale creature, navy blue with glowing constellation spots, small fins, ancient and majestic
comets.expression: small wise ancient eyes; a huge wide gentle mouth with baleen plates; serene

comets.name: Phoenix
comets.look: a round fire bird with its wings folded tight around its body like a cloak and a crest of flame feathers (nothing trailing behind)
comets.expression: sharp golden hawk eyes; a hooked beak open in a battle cry; proud and fierce

comets.name: Frostfang
comets.look: a compact ice dragon head shaped like a ball: curled ice horns and a ridge of frost spikes along the back
comets.expression: icy blue reptile eyes with slit pupils; a fanged jaw with cold mist; predatory

comets.name: Midas
comets.look: a solid polished gold ball studded with cut gems
comets.expression: round coin-like eyes with ruby pupils; a greedy grin full of gold teeth; greedy

comets.name: Singularity
comets.look: a pitch-black sphere with a glowing violet accretion ring orbiting around its middle like a planet ring, light bending at its edges
comets.expression: two glowing violet ring eyes with black centers; a mouth that is a swirling vortex; ominous

comets.name: Supernova
comets.look: a star bursting through cracked dark armor plates, white-gold light blasting out of every crack
comets.expression: furious blazing eyes; a roaring wide-open mouth pouring light; pure rage

comets.name: Galaxy
comets.look: a sphere of dark glass with a whole spiral galaxy swirling inside, tiny planets orbiting close around it
comets.expression: eyes with star-shaped pupils; a serene knowing smile; all-knowing

comets.name: Chrono
comets.look: a bronze clockwork sphere with two thin crossed rings orbiting it and gears visible through glass panels
comets.expression: eyes that are two little clock dials with moving hands; a small precise smile with square cog teeth; calculating

comets.name: Eclipse
comets.look: a sphere split down the middle: one half a blazing golden sun, the other half a cold silver moon
comets.expression: the face is split too: one eye golden fire, the other pale silver; the mouth half grin, half frown; two-faced

comets.name: Visitor
comets.look: a smooth silver biomechanical orb with glowing green seams and a thin saucer ring around its middle
comets.expression: huge black almond-shaped alien eyes; a tiny thin slit mouth, no nose; eerily calm

comets.name: Xenobloom
comets.look: an alien carnivorous seed-pod: dark purple chitin petals clamped shut around a glowing green core
comets.expression: two glowing green slit eyes between the petals; the petals part like a mouth showing rows of glowing green needle teeth; predatory

comets.name: Blue Comet
comets.look: a sleek blue ice-glass ball with short swept-back fin spikes on its head, built for speed (no trail)
comets.expression: determined narrowed racer eyes; a confident grin; a speed demon
